name: Alejandro Lopez Ruiz
subtitle: Data Science | AI | Analytics
heroHeadline: Building data-driven products that connect analytics, AI, and business value.
heroDescription: I'm a Data Science and AI student who builds things end-to-end: from understanding what question to ask, to deploying the answer. My work spans NLP pipelines, econometric models, and business analytics that made it into real operations.
aboutText: I'm a Data Science and AI student who enjoys seeing a project through to something real, not just a working model. On a sustainability challenge for DSV, I led the team as captain; the fleet-charging workflow we proposed was implemented by DSV and cut estimated operational costs by around 80%. On PEPAdb, an archaeological database for the University of Seville, I was frontend lead and kept in regular contact with the client while building most of the interface myself. And on the side, I built LUNA, the assistant on this site, a RAG-based agent with real-time voice and an avatar synced to its own speech, on my own from start to finish.

What ties these together is that I like staying close to the whole problem, not just the modeling part: talking to the people who'll use the thing, and building it myself when that's what it takes. I'm comfortable moving between a notebook, a client call, and a codebase, and that's the kind of work I'm looking for.
